name: contextual-capability-manager
description: Discover, install, and use approved agent skills and MCP tools during an active task.

interface.shortDescription: Add approved capabilities while an agent works.
interface.longDescription: Finds uninstalled skills, plugins, and connectors and applies approved capabilities through a session-scoped MCP gateway.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the capability manager if this task needs a skill or connector that is not available yet.
